unlisted_practices: Incorporate AI-based diagnostic tools and AI literacy training into medical education so clinicians understand their capabilities, limitations, and best practices.

Collect large-scale, multicenter, diverse voice datasets linked to clinical data to train and validate voice biomarker models.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article presenting recommendations and frameworks for scalable clinical validation, regulatory compliance, and data governance for AI voice biomarkers.
